name: hedera-committee
description: USD-denominated digital ROSCA (committee) on Hedera: Chainlink HBAR/USD oracle, HSS scheduled payouts, HCS audit log.

envVars.description: Hedera account ID (0.0.x) whose ECDSA key signs committee audit messages on HCS
ECDSA private key for the HCS operator account - server side only, never commit
HCS topic ID for committee audit records, printed by npm run hardhat:hcs:topic --
Hedera JSON-RPC endpoint the server uses to verify tx receipts (default: Hedera testnet)

instructions: +Fund a testnet deployer with the Hedera Portal faucet, then deploy: {run:framework:deploy} --network hederaTestnet
Committee installments are USD-denominated; the Chainlink HBAR/USD feed prices each contribution at deposit time.
Local Hardhat has no HSS precompile, so the deploy script wires a MockScheduleService there.
